淡彩手绘：191，A digital illustration shoot from a portrait camera angle about a young woman with long, wavy dark hair wearing a white dress with a light green sash, standing in front of a large window with a blue sky visible outside. the image also shows a soft, pastel color palette. on the middle of the image, a 20-year-old woman with light skin appears to be standing with her hands on her hips, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. she has long, dark brown hair styled in a side braid and is wearing silver earrings. her eyes are brown and her hair is parted to the side, framing her face. she is wearing a strapless white dress that accentuates her slim body and has a green ribbon around her waist, adding a touch of elegance to her overall look. the background is a simple, light blue room with large windows, allowing soft light to filter through and create a dreamy atmosphere.
